semiconductor_relevance: High — Green Excel Poland specializes in cleanroom and dry room solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing and related industries.
summary: Green Excel Poland is a leading manufacturer of cleanroom and dry room solutions, providing high-quality and cost-effective architecture solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products are widely utilized in microelectronics, semiconductors, and other high-tech sectors, ensuring compliance with stringent quality management standards.
capabilities: Production of wall and ceiling sandwich panels with Rock Wool or Aluminium Honeycomb filling
Design and construction of cleanroom and dry room facilities
HEPA filtering systems for contamination control

regional_presence.Poland: The company is based in Wroclaw, Poland, where it manufactures its cleanroom solutions.
